newsitem.title: USA: Genesis sees 97 Q2 return on reopened mine.
newsitem.headline: Genesis sees 97 Q2 return on reopened mine.

text.p: Genesis Insurance & Financial Services Inc said Friday it expects to see a return on its investment in a Boise, Idaho, gold mine as early as the second quarter of 1997.
The company said it has reopened the Miller Mountain Gold Mine Holdings and that returns from the property will have "a direct accretive effect on consolidated accretive earnings."
The company said it expects to raise its earnings estimates to compensate for the anticipated revenue.
It said it currently projects $0.14 per share for 1996 and $0.42 per share for 1997, but said "those figures will more than likely be revised upward in the near term."
